description: This file contains the ManageController class, which handles user account management functionalities such as viewing and updating profile information, password management, external logins, and two-factor authentication in an ASP.NET Core MVC web application.

classes.name: ManageController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing user profile, password, external logins, and two-factor authentication features.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Handles GET request to display user account details.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Handles POST request to update user profile information.

methods.name: SendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Sends email verification to the user.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Handles GET request to display change password page.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Handles POST request to change the user's password.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: Handles GET request to display set password page.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: Handles POST request to set a new password.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Displays current external login providers linked to the user.

methods.name: LinkLogin
methods.description: Initiates linking an external login provider.

methods.name: LinkLoginCallback
methods.description: Completes linking an external login provider after external authentication.

methods.name: RemoveLogin
methods.description: Removes a linked external login from the user account.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Displays 2FA status and options.

methods.name: Disable2faWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before disabling 2FA.

methods.name: Disable2fa
methods.description: Disables two-factor authentication for the user.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Displays page to enable authenticator app for 2FA.

methods.name: ShowRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Displays 2FA recovery codes.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticatorWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before resetting authenticator app.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticator
methods.description: Resets the user's authenticator key.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Generates new 2FA recovery codes.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodesWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before generating new recovery codes.
